answer_text:
Here are some funny, quirky, and downright weird habits that many people secretly have — you might even recognize a few of your own!

---

### 🖊️ 1. Doodling During Phone Calls
There are a handful of people who doodle during phone calls to help keep them focused. Sometimes, they don't even know they're doing it until they're off the phone.

---

### 🗣️ 2. Talking to Inanimate Objects
Many people have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after accidentally bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it decides to freeze right in the middle of something important.

---

### 🚿 3. Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower
The shower seems to be the perfect place to rehearse arguments. The most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while you're shampooing your hair — long after the moment has passed.

---

### 🛑 4. Telling Objects to "Stay"
Some people, every time they set down a breakable object or something they don't want to misplace, point at it and tell it to "stay" out loud, like you would to a dog. They never thought it was weird until someone saw them do it and asked if they were afraid it would walk off.

---

### 🥦 5. Eating Foods Separately
Some people eat things separately — for example, eating all the chicken first and then the broccoli. Many don't even realize it's considered weird until someone points it out, yet they still do it out of habit.

---

### 🗑️ 6. Folding Trash Neatly
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, gum wrappers — anything that can be folded, they fold into a neat little square before throwing it away.

---

### 🧲 7. Checking the Backseat Every Time
Some people confessed that each time they get in their car, they make sure no one is sitting in the back seat. A classic "just in case" habit!

---

### 📱 8. Stalking Their Own Social Media
Some people scroll through their own Instagram or Facebook profiles as if they were their own biggest fan — going through their posts, checking the number of likes, and feeling like a celebrity reading the comments.

---

### 🏃 9. Running After Turning Off the Lights
Some people bolt toward their room as soon as they switch off the hall light, convinced that if they ever look back, something creepy from a horror movie will be right behind them.

---

### 🤫 10. Whispering "Bless You" to Strangers
Some people feel that when someone sneezes, they *have* to say "bless you" — even if they hear a sneeze in a public place and they're not near the person and know they won't hear it, they still whisper it under their breath.

---

### 🥛 11. Shaking Store-Bought Milk
Some people shake milk jugs before pouring a glass or over cereal. One person was raised on a dairy farm, where it was necessary with fresh milk, and was about 30 before someone asked why — and they had to think for a minute before realizing they didn't need to with store-bought milk.

---

### 🍫 12. Eating Non-Food Items (Pica)
On the more extreme end, some people have a habit of eating non-food items like dirt or chalk, known as **pica**.

---

As you can see, weird habits come in all shapes and sizes — but as humans, we're all odd in our own ways, and some of our tendencies are more common than you might think!
